summary: Frontend-only test of Print2Go 'Boss nav + progress bar + one-tap reorder + celebrate' round. All 5 requested features PASS end-to-end via Playwright with data-testid selectors. Sidebar shows two groups ('Make cards' with 5 staff links + 'Boss' with 16 admin links, all clickable with no nav errors). My Jobs renders 30 job cards (from /production/jobs 200-record fetch) with 5-step progress bar (job-progress), size/finish chips (e.g., '3.5x2 (no-bleed)' + 'Not shiny'), plain status line, 'Make again' reorder button, 'myjobs-new' button; a stopped/'Needs a look' state was seen in the list. One-tap reorder from a real-customer job (BC-1263, 'TEST Walk-in') opens NewOrder directly on newjob-step-3 with size+finish chips pre-selected and customer input pre-filled correctly. Full New Order happy path (size-standard -> finish-matte -> valid 3.5x2 PDF -> Make it) yields the newjob-success screen with 'All done!' heading, a <canvas> element (canvas-confetti) rendered, no JS errors during celebrate/chime; newjob-see-jobs navigates to /production-queue and newjob-start-another resets to step 1. Regression on the 3-step wizard passes: steps advance on pick, Back button works, Make it is disabled until file chosen, non-PDF surfaces friendly newjob-error ("That file isn't a PDF. Please pick a PDF file.") with a single newjob-error-action button and no error codes.
action_items: Non-blocking: /machines page emits repeated React warning 'Encountered two children with the same key, TEST_Machine'. Unrelated to this iteration's features but worth de-duplicating (likely seeded duplicate TEST_Machine rows or missing unique key -- consider using row id instead of name as React key).
critical_code_review_comments: NewOrder.jsx useEffect prefill dependency array is empty (with eslint-disable) -- fine for one-shot, but relies on navigate replaceState to clear location.state; verified working.
ProductionQueue.jsx: recent = jobs.slice(0,30) hard-caps to 30 -- OK for demo; consider virtualization if the 200-record list needs full display.
Sidebar Boss section is a visual separator only (per user choice, intentionally unlocked). Confirmed no accidental gating.
seed_data_creation: None. Created a valid 252x144pt PDF at /tmp/bc.pdf via reportlab for upload test; created BC-1265 and one more job during happy-path testing.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All 4 new features (Boss group, job-progress bar, one-tap reorder pre-fill+jump-to-step-3, confetti+chime on success) verified via DOM (never screenshots -- headless preview shows stale spinners). Valid PDF: reportlab Canvas('/tmp/bc.pdf', pagesize=(252,144)); c.showPage(); c.save(). Preview XHR is slow on cold load; use 30s wait_for_selector for job-card-*. The only console warning found is unrelated duplicate-key on /machines page (seeded TEST_Machine duplicates).
